sn12.42:1.1: Bhagavā-Phagavā etad avoca || || Yato kho bhikkhave ariyasāvakassa pañcabhayāni verāni vūpasantāni honti || catūhi ca sotāpattiyaṅgehi samannāgato hoti || ariyo cassa ñāyo paññāya sudiṭṭho hoti suppaṭividdho || so ākaṅkhamāno attanā va attānam vyākareyya || || Khīṇanirayomhi || pe|| avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyano || || [Bhikkhave ti sabbam vitthāretabbaṃ] || ||
sn12.42:2.1: Katamāni pañcabhayāni verāni vūpasantāni honti || || Yaṃ bhikkhave pānātipāti || pe|| || Yaṃ bhikkhave adinnādāyī || pe|| || Yaṃ bhikkhave kāmesu micchācārī || pe|| || Yaṃ bhikkhave musāvādī || pe|| || Yaṃ bhikkhave surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhāyī || pe|| || Imāni pañcabhayāni verāni vūpasantāni honti || ||
sn12.42:3.1: Katamehi catūhi sotāpattiyaṅgehi samannāgato hoti || || Idha bhikkhave ariyasāvako Buddhe || pe|| Dhamme || pe || Saṅghe || pe|| Ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgato hoti || || Imehi catūhi sotāpattiyaṅgehi samannāgato hoti || ||
sn12.42:4.1: Katamo cassa ariyo ñāyo paññāya sudiṭṭho hoti suppaṭividdho || || Idha bhikkhave ariyasāvako paṭicca samuppādaññeva sādhukaṃ yoniso manasi karoti || pe || || Ayam assa ariyo ñāyo paññāya sudiṭṭho hoti suppaṭividdho || ||
sn12.42:5.1: Yato ca kho bhikkhave ariyasāvakassa imāni pañcabhayāni verāni vūpasantāni honti || imehi catūhi sotāpattiyaṅgehi samannāgato hoti || ayaṃ cassa ariyo ñāyo paññāya sudiṭṭho hoti suppaṭividdho || So ākaṅkhamāno attanā va attānaṃ vyākareyya || || Khīṇanirayomhi khīṇatiracchānayoniyo khīṇapettivisayo khīṇāpāyaduggativinipāto || sotāpanno ham asmi avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyano ti || || Dutiyaṃ || ||
